caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular block of stone with a rounded arch opening in the center. The stone is rendered in shades of brown and beige, showing texture through lines and shading that suggest weathering and roughness. The arched opening is outlined with several concentric bands of stone, with the innermost band being darker to indicate depth. The area inside the arch is left blank, contrasting with the detailed stonework around it. There are visible cracks and irregularities on the surface of the stone, emphasizing its aged appearance. The background of the drawing is plain, off-white, with a faint reddish hue around the edges of the stone block, possibly to suggest a shadow or aura. In the bottom right corner, the signature "V. Van Voris" is present in small text.
title: Chapel Window
